_why: Shrink-only list of car fields written as c.<name> in js/game.js, js/physics/*.js, js/race/*.js that js/race/car-fields.js does not declare (#6920 U1.4). Declare a name there (GROUPS + a RESET_GROUPS row) and delete its entry here in the same PR; tests/unit/car-field-writes.test.mjs fails on a stale entry.

_xSndWant.note: per-frame engine-sound target scratch; written every frame so it never leaks, but has no RESETS row

wrongCueT.note: wrong-way cue countdown (`(c.wrongCueT || 0) - dt`); a stale value only delays the next cue

parkedOnRoad.note: retired car's on-road flag, set once at retirement

gripSteerCapSm.note: smoothed GRIP STEER cap, player only; carries across a rescue or episode

duelRival.note: marks the duel rival car; set at duel start, never cleared by a reset

legendId.note: legend driver id on a duel rival

dsq.note: disqualification marker; three writers, none reset by the table

replayRate.note: replay playback speed multiplier on a puppet car (game.js revs it from c.speed x c.replayRate)

braking.note: replay puppet brake flag, written every pose

skipWhy.js/game.js :: saveTeamParts: c is the career fitted-parts record (careerFitted), not a car
skipWhy.js/race/race-radio.js :: offer: c is a radio message object (still, cdKey, born, exp), not a car
skipWhy.js/race/race-radio.js :: refreshLastLap: c is a radio message object (vars, key), not a car
